decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly getting big creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them onto the battlefield to overwhelm opponents. Key cards like Reanimate, Entomb, and Animate Dead are crucial to this strategy, while also utilizing disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to close out the game quickly. The mana base is built to support these plays with fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all necessary colors.

The main concept of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer. Chalice of the Void helps disrupt opponents' plans while Cavern of Souls ensures our Eldrazi spells can't be countered. The deck also includes aggressive creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Glaring Fleshraker to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Wasteland allows us to disrupt our opponent's mana base and control the board, while Eye of Ugin helps us tutor for important Eldrazi creatures.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact cards in combination with blue spells to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. By using cards like Mishra's Bauble, Chalice of the Void, and Urza's Bauble, the deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Pinnacle Emissary provide additional value by recurring artifacts and providing extra creatures on the battlefield. Through efficient mana ramp with Mox Opal and powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The main idea of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to ramp up quickly with cards like Ancient Tomb and Eldrazi Temple to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher ahead of schedule. Chalice of the Void can disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Eldrazi Linebreaker provide aggressive threats. The deck also includes removal like Kozilek's Command and Wasteland to control the board. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression and disruption through efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and countermagic. The goal is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Nethergoyf to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes some graveyard synergy with cards like Reanimate and Murktide Regent, adding another layer of versatility and power to the aggressive game plan. Ultimately, it aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the combo of using Nomads en-Kor with Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw through your deck and find answers or win conditions. It includes a mix of control elements such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to disrupt the opponent's game plan while utilizing Green Sun's Zenith and Ponder to set up your combo pieces. The deck also includes a variety of utility creatures and lands to support the combo and protect your key pieces.

The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently putting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its game plan, as well as efficient card selection with Ponder and Brainstorm. The key strategy is to use graveyard recursion to cheat powerful creatures into play while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and hand disruption. The deck aims to win the game through powerful combos and overwhelming the opponent with fast, efficient threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the game through a combination of disruption and quick threats. Utilizing cards like Stifle, Lightning Bolt, and Force of Will to disrupt opponent's plays while deploying threats like Brazen Borrower and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to outpace the opponent with efficient plays and tempo swings, using cards like Daze and Wasteland to further disrupt opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game while steadily chipping away at the opponent's life total.

The main concept of this deck is to use aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, to quickly pressure the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Wasteland and Daze to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain tempo. By efficiently controlling the board and applying pressure, the deck aims to quickly defeat the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Will adds another layer of protection and interaction to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful dragons and disruptive enchantments to lock down the opponent's resources and crush them with aggression. By using cards like Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, and Magus of the Moon, the deck aims to limit the opponent's options while quickly deploying threats like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. The combination of fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Chrome Mox, along with powerful removal spells like Sundering Eruption and Fury, allows the deck to maintain control of the board while applying pressure.

This UWx Control deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. By removing threats and countering key spells, this deck can stabilize the board and ultimately win through incremental advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana for its powerful spells.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck has a mix of threats like Murktide Regent, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to quickly close out the game once the combo is established. Overall, the goal is to outpace the opponent with explosive graveyard-based plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. Cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brazen Borrower provide additional utility and disruption while spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game while disrupting their game plan.

The main concept of this Legacy deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by casting a series of spells that allow you to mill your entire library, then win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck utilizes a mix of fast mana, disruption, and graveyard manipulation to facilitate this game plan. The key cards are Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, which mill your entire library when they enter the battlefield, and Thassa's Oracle, which wins the game if your library is empty. The deck aims to execute its combo as early as possible while protecting it with Pact of Negation.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, and then bring them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect your combo pieces, as well as disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Nihil Spellbomb to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and Atraxa, Grand Unifier offers additional versatility. The deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and overwhelming your opponent with powerful threats.

The focus of this control deck is on utilizing a combination of counter spells and removal to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also ramping up mana to cast powerful spells and creatures. By efficiently controlling the game and manipulating card advantage through card draw and selection, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent in the long run. The mana base is designed to provide flexibility for casting spells of various colors, ensuring access to a wide range of powerful options throughout the game.
